feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 June 2026 8:14am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 16 June 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic and high pressure over continental Europe as weak fronts affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, increasing 4 or 5 in central to western areas but mainly south or southeast 3 or less elsewhere. Becoming southwest 4 or 5 in all waters tonight. Then decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and fog patches. Rain for a time later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 to 5, increasing 5 or 6 early Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Any mist and fog patches at first quickly clearing to become mainly fair. Rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and mist and very poor in fog patches.
